title: MoE thresholds consumed by the mod
description: 200 response of GET /v1/moe/{tank_id} as the mod reads it (extra fields are ignored). Damage values are the combined MoE metric: damage dealt + max(radio assist, track assist, stun assist), as a 100-battle EMA. The mod needs at least thresholds; an optional dense curve improves the in-battle percent projection. 404 = no data for this vehicle (the panel shows 'no thresholds'). The mod sends X-Otmetki-Device when bound, no signature, and caches the answer for 6 hours.

thresholds.description: Keys are percent levels as strings. 65/85/95 are the 1/2/3 mark levels; 100 is optional.

mastery.description: Optional: the base XP one battle needs for each mastery badge (3rd, 2nd, 1st class, Ace Tanker) on this vehicle.

curve.description: Optional percentile curve, any number of points, will be sorted and made monotonic by the mod.
